title: Offer Rationale Kit and Decision Traceability Protocol
author: Samantha Lee
content:
Summary:
This document defines Redwood Inference’s standard for composing, approving, and storing offer rationales and the associated decision traceability artifacts. It ensures hires, internal promotions, and compensation exceptions are: auditable, defensible, and consistent with compensation bands, legal constraints, and diversity-equity goals.

Scope:
- Applies to all full-time, part-time, contractor conversion offers, internal promotions with comp changes, and any off-band or sign-on exceptions.
- Excludes routine offer renewals that are administrative (see HR payroll runbook).

Goals:
- Capture the evidence and approver trail for every offer.
- Reduce time-to-offer without sacrificing compliance or manager accountability.
- Provide a searchable decision log for audit, calibration, and future reference.

When to use this kit:
1) New hire offers (external candidates).
2) Internal promotions or role changes that change pay, grade, or equity.
3) Any requested deviation from published comp bands or standard sign-on practices.

Roles & responsibilities:
- Hiring Manager: Provide role context, candidate assessment, and initial compensation recommendation. Responsible for writing the offer rationale.
- People Partner (Recruiter/HRBP): Validate market data, flag policy exceptions, submit to approval workflow, and ensure documentation is complete.
- Compensation Approver (Finance/People ops): Final sign-off on off-band requests and any non-standard equity.
- Legal (when applicable): Review clauses for regulated hires or international hires with special contract terms.
- Hiring Committee (optional): For senior ICs, managers, and leadership hires; provides recorded consensus notes.

Process (step-by-step):
1. Manager completes the Offer Rationale Template (section below) within the ATS or People Ops portal. Attachments: candidate resume, interview scorecards, reference check summary, market comp data (LinkedIn/levels.fyi/internal comp pulls).
2. People Partner checks completeness and market alignment; if within band, marks for People Partner approval.
3. If the request is off-band or includes sign-on/relocation/equity exceptions, route to Compensation Approver.
4. Compensation Approver reviews within 48 hours (SLA). Approver either Approves, Requests more justification, or Rejects.
5. Upon approval, People Partner issues the offer and saves the executed offer letter and signed acceptance to the candidate record.
6. All artifacts are archived to the Offer Decision Log (see Documentation & storage).

Approval matrix (roles vs authority):
| Decision type                         | Hiring Manager | People Partner | Compensation Approver | Legal |
|---------------------------------------|----------------|----------------|-----------------------|-------|
| Within-band base comp                 | Recommend      | Approve        | N/A                   | N/A   |
| Off-band base comp (+/- 10%)          | Recommend      | Recommend      | Approve               | N/A   |
| Off-band base comp (> +/-10%)         | Recommend      | Recommend      | Approve (CFO signoff)| N/A   |
| Sign-on bonus / relocation             | Recommend      | Recommend      | Approve               | N/A   |
| Equity > standard grant               | Recommend      | Recommend      | Approve               | N/A   |
| Non-standard clauses (NDAs/IP/custom) | Recommend      | Recommend      | Recommend             | Review|

Time targets & SLAs:
- People Partner initial completeness check: 24 hours.
- Compensation Approver decision on off-band: 48 hours.
- Total time-to-offer target (from verbal approval to written offer): 24 hours for within-band; 72 hours for off-band.

Offer Rationale Template (required fields):
- Role (title, team, location):
- Reason for hire (replace headcount, new capability, critical business need):
- Candidate summary (2–3 sentences):
- Recommended base salary: $ value + currency
- Market comp evidence: source links and median comp for role/level
- Equity recommendation: RSU/option amount, vesting, and rationale
- Sign-on or relocation: amount and justification
- Off-band explanation (if applicable): why standard band does not apply; examples of market constraints or candidate unique skills
- Interview score summary: list of interviewers and final scores (attach scorecards)
- References summary (positive/concerns)
- People Partner notes: market context and recommended approver route
- Approvals: name, role, timestamp, decision (approve/deny/conditional)

Required attachments checklist:
1. Resume/CV
2. Interview scorecards (PDF)
3. Reference check notes
4. Market comp evidence (screenshots, reports)
5. Draft offer letter

Documentation & storage:
- All completed templates and attachments MUST be stored in the centralized Offer Decision Log (serviced by People Ops). Entry keys: candidate ID, role ID, hiring manager, date, approval chain.
- Archive retention: 7 years for hires (legal/regulatory requirement for some locations).
- Access: restricted to People Ops, Compensation, hiring manager, HRBP, and Legal (on request).

Audit & reconciliation:
- Quarterly audit: sampling of 10% of hires for compliance with template and approvals. Audit owner: Head of People Ops.
- Monthly calibration: cross-team review of high-band and off-band approvals to surface systemic issues.
- Metrics reported: average time-to-offer, % off-band offers, median approved deviation from band, diversity indicators for hires.

Decision traceability fields (machine/searchable):
- decision_id: unique UUID
- created_by: user id
- role_id, candidate_id, manager_id
- approval_chain (ordered list of approver ids)
- final_decision, decision_timestamp
- attached_documents_ids (list)
(These fields are implemented in the People Ops portal schema — use the portal form; do not try to replicate ad-hoc spreadsheets.)

Escalation & exceptions:
- If Compensation Approver does not respond in 48 hours, escalate to Head of People Ops.
- For international hires with country-specific rules, Legal must be looped before offer issuance.
- Emergency hires (market-critical within 7 calendar days): use the Emergency Approval route and document retrospective approvals within 5 business days.

Training & rollout:
- People Ops runs a 30-minute training for hiring managers and recruiters covering the template and the approval workflow.
- New manager checklist (must complete prior to first hire): Attend training, review 5 sample rationales, and shadow an offer review.

Appendix: Example filled rationale (redacted)
- Role: Senior Inference Engineer, Serving Runtime
- Reason: Replace departed senior IC to maintain backlog velocity on kernel optimizations
- Candidate summary: Ex-ML infra engineer with 7 years in inference systems, specialized in kernel fusion and quantization.
- Recommended base: $180,000 USD (Level: IC4)
- Market evidence: Internal median for IC4 is $170k; external offers indicate $175–185k in Bay Area; candidate has direct experience shipping open-source kernels.
- Equity: 8,000 RSUs one-time grant (above standard 6,000) justified by rare skill set and retention risk.
- Sign-on: $10,000 (relocation assistance).
- Interview scores: 8/10 average across system design and coding; references positive.
- Approvals: People Partner (Elena Gomez) — approved; Compensation Approver (Finance) — approved.

Appendix: Quick checklist for hiring managers (pre-offer)
1. Complete Offer Rationale Template in portal.
2. Attach scorecards, references, market evidence.
3. Confirm headcount and requisition is active.
4. Notify People Partner to start approval route.
5. Do not verbally commit off-band terms prior to Compensation Approver sign-off.
